transcription: Function names, levels and class thresholds are transcribed from the standard's structure, not quoted from a licensed copy; verify against the standard before any contractual or regulatory use. The formal class is assigned by an assessor over the installed equipment.

functions.name: Emission control (room temperature)
functions.p0_evidence: P0: one scheduled setpoint for every zone (runner.baseline)
functions.p3_evidence: per-zone heating setpoint written and read back through the governed tools (`set_zone_setpoint`, `ZONE-0x.AirTemp`); no presence sensor in the twin, so not level 4

functions.name: Control of distribution network hot-water temperature
functions.p3_evidence: weather-reset tank following the radiator curve, demand-held on price and peak (`weather_reset`, `price_ranked_charge`, `set_tank_setpoint`)

functions.name: Intermittent control of emission and/or distribution
functions.p0_evidence: P0: fixed 1 h preheat and schedule
functions.p3_evidence: self-tuning optimal start (`ReheatLearner`), recovery-limited setback by outdoor mean, occupancy horizon (`optimal_start`, `recovery_setback`, `setback`)

functions.name: Heat-pump generator control
functions.p3_evidence: tank setpoint from the weather curve plus demand hold; compressor cap for the peak budget (`set_heat_pump_limit`, ADR-011)

functions.name: Thermal energy storage control
functions.p0_evidence: P0: tank charged on hysteresis only
functions.p3_evidence: charging ranked by the day-ahead price and held before a peak block (`price_ranked_charge`)
functions.note: The twin's price-ranked charging is prediction-based on the published day-ahead price, not on a load forecast.

functions.name: Emission control (room temperature)
functions.p3_evidence: per-zone cooling setpoint through `set_zone_cooling_setpoint`, unoccupied setback (`unoccupied_cooling_setback`)

functions.name: Interlock between heating and cooling
functions.p0_evidence: IL-01: the twin refuses a cooling setpoint within 2 K of heating
functions.p3_evidence: IL-01 held by the twin, the signed ToolSpec and the caretaker's validator

functions.name: Supply-air flow control at room level
functions.p3_evidence: DCV on CO2 in every zone (`ZONE-0x.CO2Setpoint`, `set_zone_co2_setpoint`), IAQ overlay keeps the AHU on above 950 ppm

functions.name: Heat-exchanger icing protection
functions.p3_evidence: same (plant function, not a caretaker lever)

functions.name: Free mechanical cooling
functions.p3_evidence: summer night purge through the HRV bypass (`night_purge`); the twin has no modulated free-cooling damper
functions.note: Free cooling from the energy wells (`free_cooling_eer`) is a plant property of SITE_001, not a controlled function.

functions.name: Supply-air temperature control
functions.p3_evidence: Trim & Respond on zone requests outside the heating season (`trim_respond`, `set_supply_air_setpoint`)

functions.name: Occupancy control

levels.3: automatic detection, auto on / auto off

functions.p0_evidence: P0: lighting on the schedule (`schedule` mode)
functions.p3_evidence: presence mode: lit while people are present, off when they leave (`set_zone_lighting_mode`)

functions.name: Daylight control
functions.p3_evidence: daylight harvesting to the lux setpoint (`daylight_harvesting`)

functions.name: Detecting faults of technical building systems and support to diagnosis
functions.p3_evidence: zone-sensor FDD: stale, frozen, drifted, mis-mapped readings alarmed with evidence and ground truth (`fdd-alarms.jsonl`); escalation route to a human

functions.name: Reporting energy consumption, indoor conditions and possibilities for improvement
functions.p3_evidence: every decision record carries context, algorithms and validation; energy by consumer, comfort, IAQ and tank safety reported per day (`runner.areas`, `runner.pilot`)

functions.name: Smart-grid integration (demand response)
functions.p3_evidence: demand-response profile on the day-ahead price, peak limiter and monthly peak budget on the grid tariff's power part (`demand_response`, `peak_limiter`, `peak_budget`)

functions.name: Domestic hot-water storage control
functions.note: The twin has no domestic hot water; SITE_001's electric hot water is a constant auxiliary load. A site with DHW adds a water-safety overlay before any energy function.

requirements: non-residential buildings with heating, air-conditioning or combined systems of effective rated output over 290 kW: building automation and control systems (continuous monitoring, logging, analysis and adjustment; benchmarking against reference values; fault detection and alerting; interoperability)
the same for systems over 70 kW, by 31 December 2029
epbd.note: Norway's transposition through the EEA agreement is pending; the thresholds are given as the directive states them, as the market signal the caretaker's functions answer, not as a Norwegian legal requirement.

reading: The class floor is the lowest grade of any applicable function, which is how the standard assigns a class; a single function at a low level holds the whole building down. The grade counts show where the caretaker sits per function.

cross_check.reading: The BAC factors are statistical defaults for a typical office in the standard's reference climate, not a prediction for this building; the simulated saving is one building on one year of weather. Agreement in order of magnitude is the check; a ratio far from 1 says the twin's as-found case or its levers differ from the standard's reference, and why should be stated.
